about: Answer key for held figures, `figure.not-held`, `figure.mismatch`, the note rule and ruling R59 (step 2B, PR 5), written by the controller by reading, under the coordinator's rulings P1 to P9 and R59 and the controller's R60 to R62 of 2026-11-14. `reader`: rows read as in figures.json (each figure [value, negative, bracketed, unit, currency, shown, column]); here they pin the note rule. `cases`: documents built as in figures.json (`front` + head + `findings` + `tail`; the head is six lines, so the text under a leading `### Bottom line` is line 8; `kind` defaults to data; a case's `tail` replaces the default and holds the held text under `## Calculations`). Each expected finding is [check, severity, line, quoted]; `columns` lists the column of each finding in order; `reason_has` and `reason_lacks` map a finding's index to text its reason holds or lacks; a case with `known_false_refusal` records a refusal known to be wrong and not closed. The findings of a case are compared whole and in order.
